description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for the dashboard modules API, providing endpoints to retrieve overview metrics and counts related to users, tenants, projects, sessions, deployments, and costs. It imports models and services, performs database queries with fallbacks, and structures JSON responses for frontend consumption.

methods.name: GET /api/dashboard/overview/modules
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a summarized overview of dashboard modules, including counts and usage metrics, with fallbacks for missing data.

methods.name: GET /api/dashboard/overview/metrics
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve total counts for users and deployed applications, with fallback logic for missing user data.
